Burn it All Campaign

Dallas, TX / 20258 photographs
About the project

Shot in the dead of winter in Dallas, Burn It All is a visually explosive campaign for Hashira Studios’ new hoodie and pant drop. Conceived by creative director Julio Sanchez, it explores toxic love against a backdrop of surreal destruction, from nuclear blasts to a city seemingly engulfed in flames.

I led photography, lighting, editing, and video direction, working with models Bethany and Andrew to capture moments that feel intense and cinematic. Despite 20-degree weather and a generator that froze mid-shoot, we pushed through and made some of our most evocative imagery yet, with Josh Tran assisting on lighting and gaffing.
